translations.web: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
translations.bsb: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.
translations.kjv: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
translations.asv: But the king was wroth; and he sent his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
